A small pricing lesson from a gaming app: GearUP Booster is free to install and lets you browse its supported-game list, but the actual boost sits behind a plan or a 3-day free trial that renews automatically.

In the Vietnam App Store that's 39,000 VND a week, 69,000 a month or 499,000 a year. Its HYPEREV console router is $39.99 with 3 months of membership included.
